blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In trade, prices go up and down every day. Today's price can be higher or lower than yesterday. This is normal, so we compare and we learn.

Today we use five simple words: high, low, change, difference, offer. We also use easy comparatives: higher, lower, better, worse.

💛 Compare and grow — with no judgement. When the price changes, we look at the difference. Sometimes the difference is small. A little better every day is a good plan.

items.q: How often do prices go up and down in trade?
items.why: "prices go up and down every day" — todos os dias.

items.q: Today's price can be higher or lower than…
items.why: "Today's price can be higher or lower than yesterday."

items.q: How many new words does the lesson use today?
items.why: "we use five simple words: high, low, change, difference, offer."

items.q: The text says "Compare and grow — with no judgement." This suggests that…
options: it is okay to learn slowly, step by step
you should feel bad about a low price
items.why: Inferência: "no judgement" e "a little better every day" mostram que aprender aos poucos está ok.

items.q: When the price changes, the text suggests you should…
options: look at the difference and compare
items.why: Inferência: "we look at the difference" — comparar é a resposta certa a uma mudança.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan comparando o preço do açúcar de hoje com o de ontem. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. I am Ethan, and I work with sugar prices. Let me compare today with yesterday. It is easy, and I use simple words.

Yesterday the price was low. Today the price is higher. So the market went up a little. The difference is small, but it is a change. A small change is still important for us.

Now let me compare two markets. Brazilian sugar is cheaper this week. European sugar is more expensive. If you want a good price, Brazil is better today. That is a clear difference.

I also have a new offer for you. This offer is better than the last one. The price is lower and the quality is good. Last month the quality was worse, but this month it is fine.

One more thing about the season. Demand is lower in winter, so summer prices are usually higher. Freight is cheaper by sea, so we save money there.

That is all for today. Remember: a little better every day. Compare, learn, and grow. Thank you, and see you tomorrow.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How is today's price compared with yesterday?
items.why: "Yesterday the price was low. Today the price is higher."

items.q: Which sugar is cheaper this week?
items.why: "Brazilian sugar is cheaper this week."

items.q: What does Ethan say about the new offer?
options: It is worse than the last one
It is better than the last one
items.why: "This offer is better than the last one."

items.q: Ethan says demand is lower in winter. This suggests that in summer prices are usually…
items.why: Inferência: menos demanda no inverno + "summer prices are usually higher" indica preços mais altos no verão.

items.q: Why does Ethan mention that freight is cheaper by sea?
options: To show a way to save money
items.why: Inferência: "Freight is cheaper by sea, so we save money there."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The price is very high today." High means…
items.why: High = alto: o preço está grande, elevado.

items.q: "Demand is low in winter." Low means…
items.why: Low = baixo: a demanda está pequena.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The price is not the same. There is a ___ today."
items.why: Change = mudança: o preço mudou.

items.q: "The difference between the two prices is small." Difference means…
items.why: Difference = diferença: o espaço entre os dois preços.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I have a good ___ for you: lower price and good quality."
items.why: Offer = oferta: uma boa proposta de preço.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em conversas de preços. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Sugar prices go up in summer." To go up means to…
items.why: Go up = subir: o preço fica mais alto.

items.q: "In winter, prices often go down." To go down means to…
items.why: Go down = descer: o preço fica mais baixo.

items.q: "This offer is better than the last one." Better than means…
items.why: Better than = melhor do que: esta oferta é superior à anterior.

items.q: "The quality is worse than last month." Worse than means…
items.why: Worse than = pior do que: a qualidade caiu.

items.q: "Freight by sea is cheaper." By sea means the goods travel…
options: on the ocean, on a ship
items.why: By sea = por mar, de navio: o frete marítimo é mais barato.
